    <style>

            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html,

            margin: 0;

            min-height: 100%;
        }

            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            background: #172235;

            text-align: center;
        }

        h1 {

        }

        .subtitle {

        .top-panel {

        }

        .info-box {

        }

            width: 100%;

        }

        .timer-bar {
            width: 100%;

            background: #f5a000;
            transition: width 0.05s linear;
        }

        .question-box {
            background: #29364b;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 25px 15px;
            margin-bottom: 22px;
        }

        .instruction {
            color: #aeb8c7;
            font-size: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .color-word {
            font-size: clamp(42px, 10vw, 72px);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            min-height: 90px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            user-select: none;
        }

        .answers {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .color-button {
            min-height: 90px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            transition: transform 0.12s, filter 0.12s;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
                0 5px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        }

        .color-button:hover {
            filter: brightness(1.1);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .color-button:active {
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }

        .color-button:disabled {
            cursor: default;
        }

        .red {
            background: #e53935;
        }

            background: #1e88e5;

            background: #43a047;
        }

            background: #fbc02d;
        }

            min-height: 30px;
            margin-top: 18px;

        }

            color: #66d99a;

            color: #ff7373;
        }

            padding: 20px;
        }

        .message-box {
            width: min(380px, 100%);
            background: #202c40;

            box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        }

        }

        .hidden {
            display: none !important;
        }

<body style="visibility: hidden;">

    <div class="game-container">

        <h1>🎨 Color Match</h1>

        <div class="subtitle">
            Match the color, not the word!
        </div>


        <div class="top-panel">

            <div class="info-box">
                ⭐ Score:
                <span id="score">0</span>
            </div>

            <div class="info-box">
                🏆 Best:
                <span id="bestScore">0</span>
            </div>

            <div class="info-box">
                🎯 Round:
                <span id="round">1</span>
            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="timer-container">

            <div
                class="timer-bar"
                id="timerBar">
            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="question-box">

            <div class="instruction">
                Chọn màu mà chữ đang được hiển thị
            </div>


            <div
                class="color-word"
                id="colorWord">
                RED
            </div>

        </div>


        <div
            class="answers"
            id="answers">

            <button
                type="button"
                class="color-button red"
                data-color="red">
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="color-button blue"
                data-color="blue">
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="color-button green"
                data-color="green">
            </button>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="color-button yellow"
                data-color="yellow">
            </button>

        </div>


        <div
            class="feedback"
            id="feedback">
        </div>


        <div class="level-info">
            Tốc độ sẽ tăng dần khi bạn trả lời đúng.
        </div>


        <div class="controls">

            <button
                type="button"
                class="main-button"
                id="restartButton">
                🔄 Restart
            </button>

        </div>

    </div>


    <div
        class="game-message"
        id="gameMessage">

        <div class="message-box">

            <h2 id="messageTitle">
                🎨 Color Match
            </h2>

            <p id="messageText">
                Hãy chọn đúng màu của chữ.
                Đừng chọn theo nội dung chữ!
            </p>

            <button
                type="button"
                class="main-button"
                id="startButton">
                ▶ Start Game
            </button>

        </div>

    </div>


    <div id="html_play"></div>


    <script>

        /*
         * ============================================================
         * COLOR MATCH DATA
         * ============================================================
         *
         * Mỗi object là một màu có thể xuất hiện trong game.
         *
         * Muốn thêm màu mới thì thêm object vào đây và tạo thêm
         * button tương ứng trong HTML.
         */

        const COLOR_MATCH_COLORS = [

            {
                name: "RED",
                className: "red"
            },

            {
                name: "BLUE",
                className: "blue"
            },

            {
                name: "GREEN",
                className: "green"
            },

            {
                name: "YELLOW",
                className: "yellow"
            }

        ];


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GAME VARIABLES
         * ============================================================
         */

        const colorWord =
            document.getElementById("colorWord");

        const answers =
            document.getElementById("answers");

        const scoreElement =
            document.getElementById("score");

        const bestScoreElement =
            document.getElementById("bestScore");

        const roundElement =
            document.getElementById("round");

        const timerBar =
            document.getElementById("timerBar");

        const feedback =
            document.getElementById("feedback");

        const gameMessage =
            document.getElementById("gameMessage");

        const messageTitle =
            document.getElementById("messageTitle");

        const messageText =
            document.getElementById("messageText");

        const startButton =
            document.getElementById("startButton");

        const restartButton =
            document.getElementById("restartButton");


        let score = 0;

        let round = 1;

        let bestScore =
            Number(
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "colorMatchBestScore"
                )
            ) || 0;


        let currentAnswer = "";

        let gameRunning = false;

        let roundLocked = false;

        let timer = null;

        let roundStartTime = 0;

        let currentTimeLimit = 4000;


        const MIN_TIME_LIMIT = 1000;

        const TIME_DECREASE = 120;


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * UPDATE BEST SCORE
         * ============================================================
         */

        bestScoreElement.textContent =
            bestScore;


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * RANDOM ITEM
         * ============================================================
         */

        function randomItem(array) {

            return array[
                Math.floor(
                    Math.random() * array.length
                )
            ];

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * START GAME
         * ============================================================
         */

        function startGame() {

            clearTimer();

            score = 0;

            round = 1;

            currentTimeLimit = 4000;

            gameRunning = true;

            roundLocked = false;


            scoreElement.textContent =
                score;

            roundElement.textContent =
                round;


            feedback.textContent =
                "";

            feedback.className =
                "feedback";


            gameMessage.classList.add(
                "hidden"
            );


            nextRound();

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * NEXT ROUND
         * ============================================================
         */

        function nextRound() {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }


            roundLocked = false;


            feedback.textContent =
                "";

            feedback.className =
                "feedback";


            /*
             * Chọn màu thực tế của chữ.
             */

            const actualColor =
                randomItem(
                    COLOR_MATCH_COLORS
                );


            /*
             * Chọn nội dung chữ.
             *
             * Nội dung và màu được chọn độc lập
             * để tạo hiệu ứng đánh lừa não.
             */

            let displayedWord =
                randomItem(
                    COLOR_MATCH_COLORS
                );


            /*
             * Từ round 2 trở đi ưu tiên tạo
             * trường hợp chữ và màu khác nhau.
             */

            if (
                COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.length > 1 &&
                Math.random() < 0.8
            ) {

                const otherColors =
                    COLOR_MATCH_COLORS.filter(
                        function (item) {

                            return (
                                item.name !==
                                actualColor.name
                            );

                        }
                    );


                displayedWord =
                    randomItem(
                        otherColors
                    );

            }


            currentAnswer =
                actualColor.className;


            colorWord.textContent =
                displayedWord.name;


            colorWord.style.color =
                getColorValue(
                    actualColor.className
                );


            roundElement.textContent =
                round;


            startTimer();

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * COLOR VALUE
         * ============================================================
         */

        function getColorValue(className) {

            const colors = {

                red: "#e53935",

                blue: "#1e88e5",

                green: "#43a047",

                yellow: "#fbc02d"

            };


            return colors[className];

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * TIMER
         * ============================================================
         */

        function startTimer() {

            clearTimer();


            roundStartTime =
                performance.now();


            timerBar.style.width =
                "100%";


            timer =
                requestAnimationFrame(
                    updateTimer
                );

        }


        function updateTimer(timestamp) {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }


            if (roundLocked) {
                return;
            }


            const elapsed =
                timestamp -
                roundStartTime;


            const remaining =
                Math.max(
                    0,
                    currentTimeLimit - elapsed
                );


            const percentage =
                (
                    remaining /
                    currentTimeLimit
                ) * 100;


            timerBar.style.width =
                percentage + "%";


            if (remaining <= 0) {

                timeUp();

                return;

            }


            timer =
                requestAnimationFrame(
                    updateTimer
                );

        }


        function clearTimer() {

            if (timer !== null) {

                cancelAnimationFrame(
                    timer
                );

                timer = null;

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * ANSWER
         * ============================================================
         */

        function selectColor(color) {

            if (!gameRunning) {
                return;
            }


            if (roundLocked) {
                return;
            }


            roundLocked = true;

            clearTimer();


            if (color === currentAnswer) {

                handleCorrect();

            }
            else {

                handleWrong();

            }

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * CORRECT
         * ============================================================
         */

        function handleCorrect() {

            score +=
                calculateScore();


            scoreElement.textContent =
                score;


            feedback.textContent =
                "✓ Correct!";


            feedback.className =
                "feedback correct-feedback";


            /*
             * Mỗi round đúng sẽ nhanh hơn.
             */

            currentTimeLimit =
                Math.max(
                    MIN_TIME_LIMIT,
                    currentTimeLimit -
                    TIME_DECREASE
                );


            round++;


            setTimeout(
                function () {

                    nextRound();

                },
                220
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * SCORE
         * ============================================================
         */

        function calculateScore() {

            /*
             * Điểm cơ bản tăng dần theo round.
             */

            return 10 + Math.min(
                round,
                20
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * WRONG
         * ============================================================
         */

        function handleWrong() {

            feedback.textContent =
                "✗ Wrong!";


            feedback.className =
                "feedback wrong-feedback";


            setTimeout(
                function () {

                    endGame();

                },
                350
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * TIME UP
         * ============================================================
         */

        function timeUp() {

            if (roundLocked) {
                return;
            }


            roundLocked = true;

            clearTimer();


            feedback.textContent =
                "⏰ Time's up!";


            feedback.className =
                "feedback wrong-feedback";


            setTimeout(
                function () {

                    endGame();

                },
                350
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * GAME OVER
         * ============================================================
         */

        function endGame() {

            clearTimer();


            gameRunning = false;

            roundLocked = true;


            if (score > bestScore) {

                bestScore =
                    score;


                localStorage.setItem(
                    "colorMatchBestScore",
                    bestScore
                );

            }


            bestScoreElement.textContent =
                bestScore;


            messageTitle.textContent =
                "💥 Game Over";


            messageText.innerHTML =
                `
                    Score: <strong>${score}</strong><br>
                    Best: <strong>${bestScore}</strong><br>
                    Reached round: <strong>${round}</strong>
                `;


            startButton.textContent =
                "🔄 Play Again";


            gameMessage.classList.remove(
                "hidden"
            );

        }


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * BUTTON EVENTS
         * ============================================================
         */

        document
            .querySelectorAll(".color-button")
            .forEach(
                function (button) {

                    button.addEventListener(
                        "click",
                        function () {

                            selectColor(
                                button.dataset.color
                            );

                        }
                    );

                }
            );


        startButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                startGame();

            }
        );


        restartButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                startGame();

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * KEYBOARD SUPPORT
         * ============================================================
         *
         * PC:
         *
         * R = Red
         * B = Blue
         * G = Green
         * Y = Yellow
         */

        document.addEventListener(
            "keydown",
            function (event) {

                if (!gameRunning) {
                    return;
                }


                const key =
                    event.key.toLowerCase();


                const keyMap = {

                    r: "red",

                    b: "blue",

                    g: "green",

                    y: "yellow"

                };


                if (keyMap[key]) {

                    selectColor(
                        keyMap[key]
                    );

                }

            }
        );


        /*
         * ============================================================
         * MYWEBPLAY HTML PLAY
         * ============================================================
         */

        setInterval(function () {

            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll("center")
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());


            document
                .querySelectorAll(
                    "div[style='height: 65px;']"
                )
                .forEach((el) => el.remove());

        }, 10);


        var loadix = false;


        setInterval(function () {

            if (loadix == true) {
                return;
            }


            var formData =
                new FormData();


            formData.append(
                "website",
                "/game-color-match"
            );


            formData.append(
                "method",
                "GET"
            );


            $.ajax({

                url: "/Admin/ShowHtmlPlay",

                type: "POST",

                data: formData,

                contentType: false,

                processData: false,

                success: function (data) {

                    if (data.result == true) {

                        document
                            .getElementById("html_play")
                            .innerHTML =
                            data.html;


                        const container =
                            document.getElementById(
                                "html_play"
                            );


                        const scripts =
                            container.querySelectorAll(
                                "script"
                            );


                        scripts.forEach(
                            function (script) {

                                const newScript =
                                    document.createElement(
                                        "script"
                                    );


                                if (script.src) {

                                    newScript.src =
                                        script.src;

                                }
                                else {

                                    newScript.textContent =
                                        script.textContent;

                                }


                                document.body.appendChild(
                                    newScript
                                );


                                script.remove();

                            }
                        );


                        const styles =
                            container.querySelectorAll(
                                "style, link[rel='stylesheet']"
                            );


                        styles.forEach(
                            function (styleEl) {

                                const newEl =
                                    document.createElement(
                                        styleEl.tagName
                                            .toLowerCase()
                                    );


                                if (
                                    styleEl.tagName
                                        .toLowerCase() ===
                                    "style"
                                ) {

                                    newEl.textContent =
                                        styleEl.textContent;

                                }
                                else if (
                                    styleEl.tagName
                                        .toLowerCase() ===
                                    "link"
                                ) {

                                    newEl.rel =
                                        "stylesheet";

                                    newEl.href =
                                        styleEl.href;

                                }


                                document.head.appendChild(
                                    newEl
                                );


                                styleEl.remove();

                            }
                        );


                        loadix = true;


                        if (document.body) {

                            document.body.style.visibility =
                                "visible";

                        }

                    }
                    else {

                        document
                            .getElementById(
                                "html_play"
                            )
                            .style.display =
                            "none";


                        loadix = true;


                        if (document.body) {

                            document.body.style.visibility =
                                "visible";

                        }

                    }

                }

            });

        }, 100);

    </script>


    <script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js"></script>

</body>

</html>
